gloss: guest room; hotel room; passenger cabin

definitions.explanation: A room in a hotel, inn, or house designated for guests.
The passenger area of an airplane, ship, or train, as distinct from the crew area.

notes:
A versatile word used in both hospitality and transportation contexts.

SENSE 1 — HOTEL/INN:
- {客室|きゃくしつ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of rooms
- {客室|きゃくしつ}{係|がかり}: room attendant
- {客室|きゃくしつ}⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧: room cleaning
- {客室|きゃくしつ}{料金|りょうきん}: room rate

SENSE 2 — AIRPLANE/SHIP:
- {客室|きゃくしつ}{乗務員|じょうむいん}: cabin crew, flight attendant
- {客室|きゃくしつ}⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧: inside the cabin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: room — general, everyday word
- ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧: Japanese-style room
- ⟦{洋室|ようしつ}→洋室：15741_youshitsu⟧: Western-style room
- キャビン: cabin — loanword, used mainly for ships and planes

FORMS:
⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (guest, passenger) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room).
